work_units.name: Pull production volumes and material costs
work_units.auto_rationale: AI can assist in data extraction but human oversight is needed for context and accuracy.
work_units.evidence: An analyst pulls production volumes from the MES and material costs from the ERP.

work_units.name: Reconcile production volumes and material costs
work_units.auto_rationale: AI can help identify discrepancies, but human judgment is required to investigate variances.
work_units.evidence: They reconcile the two against work orders, and where quantities do not match they investigate the variance.

work_units.name: Allocate overhead
work_units.auto_rationale: Overhead allocation by a fixed rule can be fully automated.
work_units.evidence: Overhead is allocated by a fixed rule.

work_units.name: Prepare cost-of-goods journal entry
work_units.auto_rationale: AI can draft the journal entry, but a human must review for accuracy and compliance.
work_units.evidence: The analyst prepares the cost-of-goods journal entry.

work_units.name: Review and approve journal entry
work_units.auto_rationale: This process requires human judgment and approval.
work_units.evidence: A manager reviews and approves it.

work_units.name: Generate closing report
work_units.auto_rationale: AI can assist in generating reports from templates, but human input is needed for finalization.
work_units.evidence: The closing report is generated from a template.

work_units.name: Distribute closing report
work_units.auto_rationale: The distribution of reports via email can be fully automated.
work_units.evidence: Distributed to the plant controllers by email.
